outcome: Failure of CT (requiring further invasive procedures)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 230 women treated with chitosan-covered tamponade for postpartum hemorrhage at a university clinic's perinatal department between January 2017 and June 2022.
finding: Chitosan-covered tamponade (CT) had an overall success rate of 91.3% for treating PPH, but placenta previa in cesarean sections was identified as a primary risk factor for CT treatment failure, increasing the odds approximately 7.5-fold.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, particularly in cases of placenta previa, was associated with an increased risk of chitosan-covered tamponade treatment failure.
